title: SQL 进阶练习
description: SQL 进阶：多表 JOIN、子查询、复杂条件、聚合分组、分页优化、索引与 EXPLAIN

content.content: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;

content.tips: LEFT JOIN 查找无订单用户
content.content: SELECT u.name FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.id IS NULL;
SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u RIGHT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
SELECT a.color, b.size FROM colors a CROSS JOIN sizes b;
SELECT u.name, p.title, o.amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id;
SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id AND o.status = 'paid';
SELECT e.name, m.name AS manager FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.id;
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = 'Tom');
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products);
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE amount > 1000);
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders);
SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);
SELECT * FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > ANY (SELECT price FROM products WHERE category = 'book');
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > ALL (SELECT price FROM products WHERE category = 'book');
SELECT t.user_id, t.total FROM (SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) t WHERE t.total > 1000;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE age >= 18 AND (city = 'Beijing' OR city = 'Shanghai');
SELECT * FROM users WHERE NOT (status = 'banned' OR status = 'deleted');
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE (status = 'paid' OR status = 'shipped') AND amount > 100;

content.tips: CASE WHEN 在 SELECT 中
content.content: SELECT name, CASE WHEN age < 18 THEN 'minor' WHEN age < 60 THEN 'adult' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group FROM users;

content.tips: CASE WHEN 在 ORDER BY 中
content.content: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'paid' THEN 1 WHEN 'pending' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;
SELECT city, status, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY city, status;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM users;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM orders;
SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid_total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id;
SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING total > 1000 ORDER BY total DESC;
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY city WITH ROLLUP;
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC, amount ASC;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY last_login DESC, id ASC;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 20, 10;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 20;

content.tips: 大表分页优化（基于游标）
content.content: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id > 10000 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20;
SELECT * FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY id LIMIT 100000, 20) t ON o.id = t.id;
CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user_status ON orders(user_id, status);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_users_email ON users(email);
CREATE TABLE logs (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, content TEXT);
SHOW INDEX FROM users;
DROP INDEX idx_users_email ON users;
EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = 'tom@example.com';
EXPLAIN SELECT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'paid';
EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = 1;
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at > '2026-01-01';
